# FarmFreshNow

> Farm to Fresh. Always Fresh. FarmFreshNow sells never-frozen chicken that is
> cut after you order, weighed after cleaning, packed at 0–4 °C and delivered in
> a two-hour slot you choose, with live order tracking and an instant invoice.

## What we sell
- Fresh whole chicken (skinless, dressed)
- Curry cut (bone-in), boneless breast, boneless leg, keema
- Farm eggs
- Combo packs
- Weekly and alternate-day subscription plans

## How ordering works
1. Choose your chicken on the products page.
2. We cut it after you order — nothing is pre-cut, nothing is frozen.
3. We pack it cold with gel packs at 0–4 °C.
4. We deliver in the date and two-hour window you select, with live tracking.
